stories.title: Define clinical trial score schema and weighting contract
stories.description: Create a deterministic scoring schema defining required measures (>=3), normalization rules, weighting configuration, and final composite score structure for clinical trials.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/domain/evaluate_care_quality/clinical_trials_service.py (trial fields and filtering outputs inform available measures)

stories.title: Implement clinical trial composite scoring logic
stories.description: Build backend scoring engine that ingests trial data and computes a composite score using defined measures (e.g., phase, status, relevance, proximity) with deterministic weighting and normalization.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/domain/evaluate_care_quality/clinical_trials_service.py (provides phase, status, location, and eligibility context for scoring)

stories.title: Expose scoring via EvaluateCare facade
stories.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade to return scored clinical trials including composite score and contributing measure breakdown for downstream UI consumption.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/facades/evaluate_care_facade.py (existing orchestration layer for clinical trial retrieval)

stories.title: Unit and integration tests for clinical trial scoring
stories.description: Create tests validating scoring determinism, correct weighting application, edge cases (missing measures), and integration with clinical_trials_service outputs.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests/ (existing backend test patterns for services and validation)
